### NAME

`giskard` - Giskard — open-source evaluation and testing library for LLM agents (scan, tests, red-reporting).

### SYNOPSIS & usage

*Derived from the upstream README at generation
time; verify against `--help` where the tool is
installed.*

```
pip install giskard           # checks (+ agents, llm, core)
pip install "giskard[scan]"   # + vulnerability / quality scan
pip install "giskard[openai]" # provider SDK for LLM judges / generators
```

```
pip install giskard-checks
```

### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

> [!IMPORTANT] > **Giskard v3** is a fresh rewrite designed for dynamic, multi-turn testing of AI agents. This release drops heavy dependencies for better efficiency while introducing a more powerful AI vulnerability scanner and enhanced RAG evaluation — both now shipping natively in `giskard-scan`, with no dependency on v2. Only the legacy scan for **tabular/ML models** remains v2-only. > **Giskard v2 remains available but is no longer actively maintained.** > Follow progress → [Read the v3 Announcement](https://github.com/orgs/Giskard-AI/discussions/2250) · [Roadmap](https://github.com/Giskard-AI/giskard-oss/issues/2252) pip install giskard           # checks (+ agents, llm, core) pip inst
